dna: (biochemistry) a long linear polymer found in the nucleus of a cell and formed from nucleotides and shaped like a double helix
dna chip: a microchip that holds DNA probes that form half of the DNA double helix and can recognize DNA from samples being tested
dna fingerprint: biometric identification obtained by examining a person's unique sequence of DNA base pairs
dna polymerase: the enzyme responsible for DNA replication
dneprodzerzhinsk: port city and industrial center in east central Ukraine on the Dnieper River
dnieper: a river that rises in Russia near Smolensk and flowing south through Belarus and Ukraine to empty into the Black Sea
dnieper river: a river that rises in Russia near Smolensk and flowing south through Belarus and Ukraine to empty into the Black Sea
dnipropetrovsk: city in east central Ukraine on the Dnieper River
